<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: bold 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 1in; text-align: justify; text-indent: -1in"><b>Explanatory
Note</b></p>

<p style="font: bold 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 1in; text-align: justify; text-indent: -1in"><b>&#160;</b></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; border-right-width: 0in; border-right-color: Black; border-left-width: 0in; border-left-color: Black"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">This
Amendment No. 1 to Current Report on Form 8-K/A (this &#8220;Amendment&#8221;) amends the Current Report on Form 8-K filed by Peoples
Financial Services Corp. (the &#8220;Company&#8221;) with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission on May 27, 2026 (the &#8220;Original
Form 8-K&#8221;). The Original Form 8-K reported, among other things, the final voting results of the Company&#8217;s 2026 annual meeting
of shareholders held on May 22, 2026. The sole purpose of this Amendment is to disclose, in accordance with Item 5.07(d) of Form 8-K,
the Company&#8217;s decision regarding how frequently it will conduct future shareholder advisory votes </span>on the compensation of
the Company&#8217;s named executive officers. No other changes have been made to the Original Form 8-K.</p>

<p style="font: bold 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 1in; text-align: justify; text-indent: -1in"><b>&#160;</b></p>

<table cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" style="font: bold 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; width: 100%; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><tr style="vertical-align: top">
<td style="width: 0"/><td style="width: 1in"><b>Item 5.07</b></td><td style="text-align: justify"><b>Submission of Matters to a Vote of Security Holders</b></td></tr></table>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">(d) As previously reported in the Original Form 8-K, at the Company&#8217;s
2026 annual meeting of shareholders, the Company&#8217;s shareholders voted their preference for holding future advisory votes on the
compensation of the Company&#8217;s named executive officers every one year. In light of these results, and consistent with the recommendation
of the Company&#8217;s board of directors as set forth in the Company&#8217;s proxy statement for the annual meeting, the board has determined
that, until the next required shareholder advisory vote on the frequency of future advisory votes, the Company will hold future advisory
votes on the compensation of the Company&#8217;s named executive officers every one year.</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; background-color: white">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; background-color: white"></p>
